summary: Build AI-enabled L&D workflows, prompt libraries, and learning analytics skills in 5 practical days. Enroll your team today.
lede: AI for learning and development helps learning design, training operations, and talent development professionals build practical AI-supported workflows. It covers prompt-based content drafting, mapping skills gaps into learning paths, and interpreting xAPI-style learner data. Participants also plan evaluation using the Kirkpatrick Model and apply human review for accuracy, bias, and governance.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work in learning design, training operations, or talent development and want to apply AI in practical L&D workflows. It is especially relevant if you are responsible for content production, learner analytics, assessment design, or L&D governance.
prerequisites: Participants should have working experience in learning and development, instructional design, HR learning support, talent development, or training coordination. Familiarity with basic adult learning principles, course design, and learner assessment is expected, but no coding or data science background is required. If you already use an LMS, authoring tool, or learning analytics dashboard, that experience will help you apply the exercises more quickly. A laptop and access to a browser-based AI tool are recommended for hands-on activities.
